Cors.//: The web app, which calls the API from the browser.

Storage.//: S3Mock locally, Cloudflare R2 when deployed.

Redaction.//: Face and number plate blurring (YuNet models), plus head blurring for everyone a person detector (YOLOX) finds, run by the media worker. FaceDetectionSize: faces are searched in a copy scaled to this many pixels (small faces are found far better enlarged). Head blurs never send media to review. BlurPlateAreas: the person detector also finds vehicles, and where no plate was found on one, its lower middle (where the plate is) is blurred; this catches UK plates the plate model misses, like white front plates in headlight glare, and never sends media to review. The setup downloads the models and sets the paths; without them every upload waits for review. The rest are the defaults: detections below MinConfidence are ignored, from ConfidentAt they're blurred without review; frames are analysed every DetectEveryNthFrame at most DetectionMaxSize px. ReviewEverything true sends every upload to a moderator (live at launch). ExecutionProvider Cpu (Cuda only on a GPU worker image).

SensitiveDetection.//: Nudity and graphic content checks (CLIP), on when ModelPath is set; the setup downloads the model and sets it. Without it a stand-in that flags mostly red pictures runs locally. Graphic content at or above Threshold is marked sensitive (shown blurred, queued for a moderator); nudity at or above NudityThreshold is held for a moderator. SampleEvery: score every Nth analysed video frame.

KnownImages.//: Checking uploads against known illegal images (PDQ, SHA-256, MD5 hashes in SQL). Locally only the harmless test entries (scripts/sql/safety-test). Always on when deployed.

Email.//: SendGrid sends when SendGrid:ApiKey is set; empty (locally) = emails are written to the console. For live values see 'Going live' in docs/local-development.md.

SMS.//: Twilio sends when its settings are set; empty (locally) = texts are written to the console.

Captcha.//: Turnstile, for the public report form (it sends X-Captcha-Token). Required: empty, the setup puts in Cloudflare's public test secret, which accepts every token.

Screening.//: Text screening of posts and comments: the built-in keyword list always runs. Endpoint (optional) adds a classifier service (e.g. Detoxify); empty = keywords only. Scores from FlagThreshold publish but are flagged; from HoldThreshold they're held for review.

BlockedUrls.//: Web addresses that can't be posted (the list is in SQL; locally the test entries). How often each API copy reloads the list, and how often it's synced from its sources.

Reels.//: Daily reel plays per UK day: signed out and Free (Premium is unlimited). ViewerKeySecret hashes signed-out viewers (secret; the setup makes one).

Heatmap.//: Map squares with fewer than MinCellCount incidents are hidden. History in days by plan.

Chat.//: Ask Bad Jockeys, the Premium AI chat. On hold until a model is chosen (owner, 23 Oct 2026): leave Model empty and the chat is a placeholder that logs each question (event 4905) and answers 503 "not switched on yet"; the web app hides the chat (ASK_BAD_JOCKEYS_ENABLED in src/web/src/lib/chat.ts). Model, when chosen: an OpenAI-compatible server (Endpoint ending /v1, the model or deployment Name, ApiKey if needed). ConnectionStrings:BadJockeysChat is the read-only bjk_chat login (password BJK_CHAT_PASSWORD in bjk-core/.env). HistoryKey signs the chat history (secret, at least 32 characters; the setup makes one). Limits and history days: see the Chat module in the bjk-modules README.

Plans.//: Billing isn't built: until the identity server issues the plan claim, give accounts a plan here (user id -> free | premium | premium_plus). The setup adds yours as premium_plus.

Notifications.//: AppUrl: the web app's address, for links in notification emails. Push: web push (VAPID) keys, on when both are set; the setup makes a pair for this computer. Live: one pair per environment, never changed (see 'Going live').

Queues.//: Optional; defaults shown. The queues are tables in the messaging schema of BadJockeysDatabase (see docs/messaging.md).
